== Comlink Cursor pass, 25 October 2026 ==
'''Build notes'''
* Jedi Knights credit, exact: the 2001 rulebook lists "Evan Lorentz" under "THE DECIPHER JEDI KNIGHTS TEAM" with no role. Only Lischke, the additional designers, Boulden, Rob Burns and Dan Burns get roles. The lead now says this.
* Lead photo: crop of Decipher's DecipherCon 2002 photo PANA0035 (caption names him alone as head judge). Original, the 1998 Ambassador portrait (89×121, Decipher), and PANA0082 are in Photographs.
* Service rows: Star Trek CCG Ambassador (from December 1996, source role word) and DecipherCon 2002 Star Trek CCG World Championship head judge.
* DecipherCon 1999: Decipher's RFD audio-feed pages list "Evan Lorentz, AP designer, tells all" (Thursday 11 November) and "Evan's thoughts on Round 1 of ST finals" (Saturday 13 November). No staff or judge title for him at DecipherCon 1999 found on the archived DecipherCon pages (all 174 photo pages and 73 event/score/report pages grepped).
* Cross-links: [[DecipherCon 1999]] Star Trek section cites the Saturday feed. New stub [[Brad DeFruiter]] (redirect [[Brad De Fruiter]]).

'''Doubtful data'''
* fri26 (DecipherCon 1999): the caption does not say which man is Lorentz. The man on the left (RFD shirt, staff lanyard) matches the 1998 Ambassador portrait and the 2002 head-judge photo; the man on the right is then Richard Handley. Identification by comparison, not by caption.
* The 1998 bio page says he was "returning to the World Championships a second time"; his first Worlds year is not on the archived pages.

'''Missing data'''
* His start date at Decipher is not on a Decipher page found so far (only a login-walled profile, not used). TrekToday (22 August 2000) reports he left the Star Trek rules-questions role for another position at Decipher.
* No DecipherCon 2000 or 2001 role found (2001 was cancelled).
* [[DecipherCon 2002]] not yet cross-linked: that page has three older ARCHIVE lint flags (theforce.net 65230 now captured 20261026015217; Commons File:Chesapeake_Conference_Center.JPG capture failed) to fix first.
